title: Dr. Himadri Sahoo
text:
Harnessing nonlinear and non-Hermitian dynamics for the next generation of photonic technologies.
I am a scientist exploring quantum and complex photonic systems, driven by a curiosity to understand, control, and harness the dynamics of light.
Currently, I am a Postdoctoral Researcher in the Nonlinear NanoPhotonics Group at the University of Twente, Netherlands.

title: Research
text:
My research explores the physics of quantum and complex photonic systems, connecting fundamental wave dynamics with emerging photonic technologies.


Understanding light propagation, scattering, and disorder in complex environments.



Exploring nonlinear interactions, exceptional points, and programmable photonic dynamics.



Developing photonic platforms and methods for quantum technologies, secure communication, and information processing.
